dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged light-grey perimeters enclosing darker grey centers. Prominent clusters of 3-5 rings in the central-lateral region show a sharp gradient transition from high-intensity borders to medium-intensity interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of small, high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients. These are concentrated primarily in the posterior lateral region and along the upper dorsal edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Primary spatial relationship consists of a scalene triangle formed by the centroids of the three largest annuli in the mid-body. A secondary linear alignment of three smaller high-intensity blobs is visible along the dorsal ridge.
